dynamic_line:
*requires sentinel essences to upgrade the orb.

Select the upgrade type to show.

*lists the information of available [PASSIVE] upgrades.  *100 essence
[PASSIVE] HP Up+
Increases maximum health points.  *400 essence
[PASSIVE] HP Up++
Greatly increases maximum health points.  *900 essence
[PASSIVE] HP Up+++
Significantly increases maximum health points.  *50 essence
[PASSIVE] Invincibility Time+
Decreases the time between touches.  *200 essence
[PASSIVE] Invincibility Time++
Greatly decreases the time between touches.  *450 essence
[PASSIVE] Invincibility Time+++
Significantly decreases the time between touches.  *25 essence
[PASSIVE] Perimeter+
Increases AOE range of the orb.  *100 essence
[PASSIVE] Perimeter++
Further expands the AOE range of the orb.  *250 essence
[PASSIVE] Perimeter+++
Expands the AOE range of the orb to the fullest.  *150 essence
[PASSIVE] Celestial Healing
Allows the orb to compress essences, and blesses it with mending effects.  *250 essence
[PASSIVE] Celestial Healing+
The orb compresses large amounts of essence, further amplifying the blessed mending effects.  *150 essence
[PASSIVE] Celestial Purification
Allows the orb to compress essences, and blesses it with purifying effects.  *50 essence
[PASSIVE] Celestial Ward
Allows the orb to compress essences, and blesses it with environmental warding effects.  *1500 essence
[PASSIVE] Sentinel's Guild Warpgate
Integrates a new warpgate that leads to the sentinel's guild - a gathering place for all defenders.  This guild offers a plethora of new options such as trading.  *100 essence
[PASSIVE] Elemental Synergy
The orb will perform elemental synergies using sentinel's essences, allowing high-tier turrets to be researched/built.  *500 essence
[PASSIVE] Vorpal Synergy
The orb will perform vorpal synergies using void essences.  This allows the orb to extract and/or use them.  *500 essence
[PASSIVE] Arcane Synergy
The orb will perform arcane synergies using magical essences.  This allows the orb to extract and/or use them.  *1250 essence
[PASSIVE] Penitence
Monsters who touched the orb has a 1/2 chance to get struck by holy light, delivering an insta-kill while leaving a divine shade.  *1300 essence
[PASSIVE] Cleanse
The orb has a chance to increase a portal's decay rate.  *3000 essence
[PASSIVE] Sentinel's Guard
When preparing for a wave, the orb calls forth ethereal guards in four directions.

*lists the information of available [ACTIVE] upgrades.  *100 essence
[ACTIVE] Blinding Flash
The orb emits an extremely bright ray of light in every direction, stunning and blinding all monsters.
CC: +++ DMG: --- CD: 90 *225 essence
[ACTIVE] Shockstorm
The orb generates a thunderstorm that shocks all monsters.
CC: +-- DMG: +-- CD: 40 *225 essence
[ACTIVE] Inferno
The orb scorches an area, spreading hellish flames on targeted monsters.
CC: --- DMG: +++ CD: 100 *225 essence
[ACTIVE] Blizzard
The orb creates a hail that swoops down to all monsters, enslowing them afterwards.
CC: ++- DMG: +-- CD: 75 *125 essence
[ACTIVE] Barrier
The orb forms a force field in the inner layer, slowing down anything that passes through.
CC: ++- DMG: --- CD: 200 *300 essence
[ACTIVE] Barrier+
The orb forms a force field in the outer layer, slowing down anything that passes through.
CC: ++- DMG: --- CD: 200 *5000 essence
[ACTIVE] Judgement
The orb channels itself to create an all-out blast of holy light, striking all monsters the same way they touch the orb.
CC: --- DMG: +++ CD: 500
